Never played before?

You don't need
any of your own kit. None of it.

Turn up in old clothes and boots with ankle support. We hand you the rifle, the ammo and the rules, walk you through the safe zone, and put you with a marshal who knows the building. Nobody is thrown in at the deep end — and nobody plays alone.

What to expect → FPS & safety rules
✓

Ages 12 and up

Under 18s need a parent or guardian to sign the waiver — it's done online in two minutes.

✓

Everything is hired

Rifle, magazine, BBs and eye protection included. No UKARA needed to play a walk-on game.

✓

Wear this, not that

Boots with ankle support, long sleeves, gloves if you have them. Leave the fashion trainers at home.

✓

Four floors, no dark corners

Every floor is lit, marshalled and signed. Safe zone, toilets and hot food on site all day.

The venue

They called it
“the Stan”

One of the largest CQB sites in the country, and the third best in the UK in 2016. It closed in 2021 when the building was redeveloped. We got the keys back, and the doors are open again — four floors of the old Stanley Tools factory, still full of the same corridors, stairwells and steel.

If you played it before, you already know why it's worth the trip. If you didn't, come and find out.
